Results.ReviewText: My Spirit grill is not a new purchase. The "cook box" was defective. While I had the grill on "high" to burn off cooking residue, the back of the cook box warped and cracked. I called the 800 number that Connolly's Do It Best gave me, talked with a representative and they shipped me a new cook box, gas rods, knobs, etc. Connolly's came and picked it up, fixed it and brought it back. Hats off the Weber!!! Thank you! Only grill I will buy.
Results.Title: Repair

Results.ReviewText: I replaced my NextGrill with the Spirit E210.  I’m finding this grill to be so much better.  The cooking temperature, grill areas, and surface is consistent and works as promised.  Plenty of room for a two burner.
Results.Title: Love the Weber E210 Grill

Results.ReviewText: Just the right size.  Had a 310 for several years and during the move decided the 2 burner was enough for us.
Results.Title: Just the right size.

Results.ReviewText: We think that the quality is very good!   Very nice grill, our 1st Weber!
Results.Title: 1st Weber!

Results.ReviewText: 10 Year Warranty doesn't cover "everything". super lame
Results.Title: Good Grill. Bad Warranty

Results.ReviewText: Expensive grill for what it is, but works well and support/parts are plentiful for repairs.
Results.Title: Webber Spirit E-210 repair adventure

Results.ReviewText: This grill is a replacement as parts were not available for the Weber Spirit 200 that I had for 10 years. Love the fold-down shelves.  I also like the closed cabinet, which is partly the main reason I purchased this model.  Although, it is somewhat difficult to place the propane tank in the hanging gauge inside the cabinet.  This grill box is slightly smaller than the old Weber so I'm going to try to adapt my old Weber rotisserie for this grill. I haven't been able to use this grill yet due to the weather but hopefully this one will last just as long as my old Weber grill.
Results.Title: Weber is a good purchase.

Results.ReviewText: Well-designed product with high quality components. Best-in-class customer service during assembly! (However, would have preferred stainless steel flavor bars (purchased three 304SS alloy for 26$ only, so what is the cost differential between enameled flavor bars vs, stainless steel…).
Results.Title: Construction

Results.ReviewText: Terrific. Preheats quickly, hgh temperature when desired, even heat across the grills, and it appears to be well made. Velcro straps on the cover are genius. Customer support via text was excellent.
Results.Title: First Weber - very satisfied

Results.ReviewText: I actually bought this years ago. For some reason my grill fell off the list. Anyway. I love this grill. My wife bought it for me on Fathers day about 4 years ago. The durability of this grill is beasty. I have had no issues with this grill. It cooks food to an art. I enjoy it every time I fire it up. One of things I like about this grill is the size. It tucks away nicely in relatively small spaces. In short, you just can't go wrong with this grill.
Results.Title: Durability and portability.

Results.ReviewText: Love Weber grills....this is a replacement for an 11 year old Weber Genesis grill that we gave to my daughter and her family. It is still going strong!!! We are only downsizing and it had to be Weber cause they are the best!!
Results.Title: Weber is the Best!!

Results.ReviewText: Great looking grill.  Enjoying it.  Just the size I needed.
Results.Title: Review of Weber Spirit E-210

Results.ReviewText: Best grill ever. Even cooking and simple cleaning. If you are looking for the best 2 burner grill, we highly recommend.
Results.Title: Best Grill Ever

Results.ReviewText: Perfect size for just the two of us. Would have preferred to have a solid bottom for the tank to sit on vs. hanging. This would make changing the tank easier for more mature individuals.
Results.Title: Perfect size

Results.ReviewText: Easy to clean, nice uniform heat, efficient on gas. Best grill I’ve ever had
Results.Title: Weber Spirit II

Results.ReviewText: This Grill is perfect fit for my small patio. I have always had Weber with 3 burners before.
Results.Title: Great size

Results.ReviewText: Maneuverability, good size cooking area. Takes very little storage space, love the folding shelves.
Results.Title: Small  but don't underestimate

Results.ReviewText: Great quality and easy to assemble! The only issue I have with it are the grills have a raised horizontal ridge across the center of each grate making it difficult to use a spatula to pick up fish or burgers in one piece. They should have had an even surface. Don’t know what Weber was thinking. Otherwise a great grill!
Results.Title: Review of my new Weber BBQ grill

Results.ReviewText: Whatever you think this will be, get ready to have it exceed your expectations. From the way it lights up, to the ease of cleaning and grease management, to the smooth-rolling portability; this is the best I’ve ever experienced in 6o+ years of grilling.
Results.Title: Best practical size and performance

Results.ReviewText: Like the size, quality and price!  Have cooked on it several times and love it.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: Very good quality grill.  I will have this grill for a long time.  I would buy this grill again.
Results.Title: Spirit E-210 Weber

Results.ReviewText: Love my new grill.  Especially how easy it is to clean.  The removable drip tray and pan make it so easy.
Results.Title: Love my grill

Results.ReviewText: tres facile de montage et d'utilisation et facile d'entretien
Results.Title: tres bon charcoal

Results.ReviewText: The Spirit is a great compact grill.  The door to propane tank falls off occasionally, seems like a strange design not to have secured hinges.
Results.Title: Great grill for small family

Results.ReviewText: Build quality is great, quality of parts was nice to see while assembling. There are just enough features for me, nothing too fancy. It heats up fast and cooks pretty evenly. Cleanup is pretty quick. I would only request some more useable storage underneath like a partition of some sort to hold a booklet or the grate cleaners.
Results.Title: Nice quality product that works as it should.

46110001.Name: Spirit E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
